notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.3)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thanks for playing our game and reporting bugs! Here is our second patch of the full release. Just some teeny-tiny fixes and improvements. Nothin' fancy here.

1.0.3 

- FIX: Mancave JigsawPiece dragging bug:
I Receive: No more cursor-loving-sticky-object bug;
You Receive: No more rotating while dragging
- UPD: Hold button behaviours improved:
We noticed that hold interaction feedbacks on New Game button in Main Menu and Quit Game button in Pause Menu are unclear. To improve readability and interactability, we increased the reset times after button release and allowed buttons to be filled by either holding or pressing multiple times in succession.
These apply to all hold buttons in Main Menu and Pause Menu.
- UPD: Mancave GridLight puzzle UX improved:
We realized that getting the connection between puzzle components can be challenging, so we disable some elements once they are no longer needed to solve the next puzzles. To clarify: [spoiler]Darts and Cassettes interactions are disabled after Cassettes are placed in correct order.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch Notes (1.0.2)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thanks for playing our game and reporting bugs! Here is our first patch of the full release:

1.0.2 

FIX: Fidgety Mind achievement bug:
   - Each unique interaction in Forest scene now contributes to the achievement, as intended
NEW:  Credits in Pause Menu:
   - Credits can now be reached in Pause Menu
NEW:  Credits in Main Menu:
   - Credits can now be reached in Main Menu, by interacting with the clipboard

notes.title: NextFest Demo - Patch Notes (0.1.5+4)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here, our first patch notes 🙂 We've made some small bug fixes and updates for our NextFest Demo as follows:

0.1.5+4

- Game:
NEW: A new Layer added to Forest
UPD: CafeScene gameplay extended
UPD: Forest Signboards now animate separately from their additional props
UPD: Some audios changed
FIX: Fixed a bug preventing interactions with MainMenuButtons

- System:
UPD: Game now keeps running in background
FIX: Potential game-breaking bugs fixed

- Known Issues:

 Dollhouse musics stutter in some systems, when on an online call - like Discord
